mitochondrial morphology is a crucial factor for the function of the inner membrane proteins.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the spatial organization of the inner mitochondrial membrane is crucial for the allocation of the proton motive force and thereby for the function of mitochondrial uncoupling proteins.
the mitochondrial inner membrane is not a homogenous layer but rather a complex structure with different functional domains.
the spatial separation of proteins in the mitochondrial inner membrane is an efficient way to prevent competition for the proton gradient.
